# UltiMaker

> UltiMaker provides professional 3D printing solutions spanning industrial-grade printers, versatile material systems, and specialized engineering applications for innovation across industries.

UltiMaker offers a comprehensive portfolio of 3D printers including the industrial Factor series, versatile S series, and specialized Method series for engineering applications. The company supports 280+ materials including composites, metals, and technical polymers to enable diverse manufacturing use cases.
